note: Five constructed ATS posting pages, deliberately WITHOUT a JobPosting ld+json block and without any 'class*=company' text (most bare ATS posting pages never label the employer at all - the board's own branding IS the employer). The fallback table's shape (a hostname -> field-selector table) is an idea taken from two surveyed open-source repos, never copied; the values here lean on the one structural fact every one of these platforms shares - the posting URL's own first path segment is the hiring company's tenant slug - rather than any class name from either repo. Each entry proves the generic guesser (ynGuessJob) misses the employer (no company-shaped text anywhere on the page) while ynAtsPostingJob answers both title and employer from the URL and the page's own h1.
